title: Kling Image 4.0 Long
summary: Generate image with Kling Image 4.0 Long
description: Kling Image 4.0 Long — one tall image, 1024 px wide: a full webpage design (skill "webpage") or an ecommerce product detail page made from 1-3 product photos (skill "ecommerce", short, medium or long). The page's text follows the prompt's language. Billing per image: a webpage 675 credits; a product page 290 (short), 580 (medium) or 965 (long); plus 4 per reference image.

length.description: Product pages only: short (about 2-5 sections, 290 credits), medium (6-10, 580, the default) or long (11-18, 965). Ignored for a webpage.

num_images.description: Number of pages to generate (each one is billed).

prompt.description: What the page is for and what it should hold (sections, offers, tone). For a product page, refer to the product photos as @image_1, @image_2, @image_3. The page's text follows the prompt's language.

reference_images.description: For "ecommerce": 1 to 3 product photos (required). For "webpage": up to 2, optional: the first is the subject the page features (a product, logo or person), the second a style reference. Each bills 4 credits. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads.

skill.description: "webpage": a full webpage design (675 credits). "ecommerce": a product detail page made from 1-3 product photos (price by length).
